description: In combination with `scen7-h-SST`, quantifies the effective radiative forcing (ERF) of future changes in anthropogenic non-CH4 short-lived climate forcer emissions. Same as `scen7-h-SST`, except anthropogenic non-CH4 tropospheric O3 precursor (NMVOCs, CO, NOx) and aerosol and aerosol precursor (BC, OC, NH3, SO2) emissions are held at present-day (2021) values. Atmosphere-only counterpart of `scen7-h-AQ`.
